title: Time Delay System for Sequence Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2610.12864v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing sequence models share a critical limitation: they lack an explicit, interpretable mechanism for content-aware temporal recall. LSTMs compress everything into a single hidden state, thereby losing information about specific past events. Transformers attend to all tokens indiscriminately at quadratic cost, while state-space models like Mamba compress history into a fixed-dimensional state without explicit content-addressable memory. To address this gap, we introduce a novel framework grounded in nonlinear time-delay systems, in which the effective delay is dynamically estimated based on the semantic similarity between current and historical inputs. translated_title: 用于序列建模的时滞系统
translated_abstract: 现有序列模型存在一个共同的关键局限：它们缺乏一种显式的、可解释的内容感知时间回溯机制。LSTM 将所有信息压缩进单一的隐藏状态，从而丢失了关于特定过去事件的信息；Transformer 以二次方的计算代价不加区分地关注所有 token；而 Mamba 等状态空间模型则将历史压缩进固定维度的状态中，缺乏显式的内容可寻址记忆。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了一种基于非线性时滞系统的新框架，其中有效时滞根据当前输入与历史输入之间的语义相似度进行动态估计。我们的方法具有三项关键创新：(i) 一种可微分的语义时滞估计器，它在历史上计算内容感知的软注意力权重，生成加权历史上下文和相似度得分；(ii) 一种具有闭式累加和解的对角状态空间……
tldr: 该论文提出基于非线性时滞系统的序列建模新框架，通过可微分语义时滞估计器依据当前与历史输入的语义相似度动态估计有效时滞，从而实现显式、可解释的内容感知时间回溯机制。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a novel sequence modeling framework grounded in nonlinear time-delay systems, which dynamically estimates the effective delay based on semantic similarity between current and historical inputs via a differentiable semantic lag estimator, enabling explicit and interpretable content-aware temporal recall.
